identity.summary: UFC lists Tommy Gantt, an unbeaten lightweight from Belleville, Illinois, who started wrestling at 12. NC State's roster lists wrestler Tommy Gantt from Cahokia, Illinois (Cahokia HS), next to Belleville. UWW lists him as Thomas GANTT JR (USA), freestyle 79 kg.

national.note: Identity resolved 25 Nov 2026. The UFC profile's hometown (Belleville, IL) and NC State's roster (Cahokia, IL, Cahokia HS) are neighbouring towns in St Clair County, and the name, sport and era agree. The 2021 Pan-American gold is rank 1 in the UWW ranking table. NC State lists him as an All-American and ACC champion, which belongs to the NCAA research lane and isn't recorded here.
